seo.homeTitle: Cyprus Cleaners — Find trusted cleaners across Cyprus
seo.homeDescription: Find vetted local cleaners for your home or apartment across Cyprus. Easy booking, in-app chat, and verified reviews.
seo.cleanersDescription: Browse vetted, reviewed cleaners across Nicosia, Limassol, Larnaca, Paphos and more. Filter by city, rate, and availability.
seo.forCleanersDescription: Grow your cleaning business on Cyprus Cleaners. Set your own rate, choose your own hours, and get paid securely.
seo.privacyDescription: How Cyprus Cleaners collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
seo.termsDescription: The terms that govern using Cyprus Cleaners, including our booking, payment, and cancellation policy.
seo.contactDescription: Get in touch with Cyprus Cleaners — questions, feedback, or anything else.
seo.getStartedDescription: Find a cleaner or sign up as a cleaner on Cyprus Cleaners.

forCleaners.heroHeadline: A clean space changes how it feels to be in it.
forCleaners.heroHeadlinePost: how it feels to be in it.
forCleaners.heroSub: Your craft deserves the right clients. We make sure they can find you.
forCleaners.step1Body: Your name, cities, rate, what you do. Takes about ten minutes.
forCleaners.step2Body: They browse, read your profile, decide. You don't chase — they come to you.
forCleaners.step3Body: No middleman. No app assigning you jobs. You read it, you decide.
forCleaners.truth1: You keep everything you earn. No commission.
forCleaners.truth2: Free to join, free to stay. No subscription.
forCleaners.truth3: You pick your clients. No one assigns you work.
forCleaners.truth4: Your profile works while you already are.
forCleaners.truth5: Cyprus is small. Your reputation travels. This is where it lives online.
forCleaners.quote: Within a week I had three messages from new customers. They'd already read my profile and knew exactly what to expect — I didn't have to explain a thing.
forCleaners.closingLine: Your work already speaks for itself. Now it can do that online too.
forCleaners.heroSubPre: We built a place where that work
forCleaners.heroSubPost: Post your profile. Customers find you and write to you directly.
forCleaners.howSub: Post your profile. Customers find you. They write to you directly. No one in between.
forCleaners.howPhotoPill: ✦ Clients find you while you're working
forCleaners.archTruth2: Free to join. Free to stay. No subscription.
